title: Make Fill the one-tap Inlay look, phone first
acceptance: Choosing Inlay sets Word, a Gallery field, Thick, Fit, image ink and the look's border in one tap.
Inlay is offered only on screens 820 px wide or less until the desktop drift check passes.

evidence.note: Rhythm sheet: one lock painter for recitation (Phrase only) and Inlay (Word only), each named on the button and in the note; Default keeps Inlay in Inlay. Guard test: Inlay through the engine makes the mask active with the old Settings toggle off. The 820 px gate and phone tile were built with the looks (#466, #470, #478). Desktop drift check still open, so Inlay stays phone-first.

summary: Inlay is the one-tap Fill look: choosing it sets Word, a Gallery field, Thick, Fit, image ink and its border (RDR-020), with no Settings switch; it is offered on screens 820 px wide or less (Q3), third on a phone; in Inlay the Rhythm sheet locks Phrase and Sentence and says why, and Default keeps the word.
